lines.text: Balak struck his hands together in anger and told Balaam to flee home, saying Chemosh had denied his reward.

wrong_details.true: the LORD had denied his reward

lines.text: Balaam said a star would come from Jacob and crush the skulls of Edom, and Amalek would be destroyed.
Balaam said Asshur would take the Kenites captive, and then he returned home while Balak went his way.
